caption:
Can someone explain this? 🤔

You can pay on time for years and nobody sends a thank-you.

Miss one payment and it feels like the whole system notices.

Am I the only one who finds that exhausting?
first_comment: Be honest: what's one credit rule that still feels unfair to you? 👇

instagram.first_comment: What credit rule feels unfair to you? 👇 @creditscoretruths

card.headline: Can someone explain why one late payment outweighs years of on-time ones?
